claims.claim: You can apply for tax credits online.
claims.quote: You cannot make a new claim for Child Tax Credit or Working Tax Credit.
claims.note: The source says new claims cannot be made, and names no online route for this service.

claims.claim: You can apply or do this by phone.
claims.quote: Call HMRC: if you have a general enquiry about your tax credits
claims.note: You cannot apply, but the source lets you phone HMRC with tax credits enquiries, such as reporting a mistake in your Annual Review.

claims.claim: The service is for people already receiving tax credits.
claims.quote: Tax credits ended on 5 April 2025. No more payments will be made.
claims.note: The source says tax credits have ended and no more payments are made, so nobody is still receiving them.

claims.claim: The service is for people who have not yet migrated to Universal Credit.
claims.note: The sources do not make not having moved to Universal Credit a condition of this service.

claims.claim: Income must be below the relevant threshold.
claims.quote: exceeding the income threshold by only so much that a determination in accordance with regulations under section 13(2) provides a rate of the tax credit in his or their case
claims.note: The Act ties entitlement to an income threshold but also allows entitlement when income exceeds it by a limited amount.

claims.claim: The threshold varies by household type.
claims.quote: not exceeding the amount determined in the manner prescribed for the purposes of this paragraph in relation to the tax credit and a person or persons of that description (referred to in this Part as the income threshold)
claims.note: The threshold is set for each description of person or persons.

claims.claim: The threshold varies by hours worked.
claims.note: The sources do not link the income threshold to hours worked.

claims.claim: Working Tax Credit requires working a minimum number of hours per week.
claims.quote: is aged at least 16 and undertakes work for not less than 16 hours per week
claims.note: The regulations set minimum weekly working hours for the basic element.

claims.claim: The minimum is 16 to 30 hours depending on age and circumstances.
claims.quote: (c) is aged at least 25 and undertakes not less than 30 hours work per week
claims.note: The regulations set 16 or 30 hours depending on age, disability, children and couple status.

claims.claim: Child Tax Credit requires being responsible for at least one child or young person.
claims.quote: The entitlement of the person or persons by whom a claim for child tax credit has been made is dependent on him, or either or both of them, being responsible for one or more children or qualifying young persons.
a person is a child if he has not attained the age of sixteen
claims.note: The Act defines a child as under 16.

claims.claim: Young people under 20 in approved education also count.
claims.quote: a person ceases to be a qualifying young person (unless disqualified earlier under the following paragraphs) on the date on which he attains the age of [ F1 twenty ]
claims.note: The regulations cover young people under 20 in full-time non-advanced education or approved training.
